text: Open tote or zipped hobo: where do your keys end up?
Put your open tote next to the Hobo Bag and look at the details. They tell you which one to carry. Here they are, one pair at a time.
The sides. An open tote has one big space, so your keys sink. The Hobo Bag has a gold zip on each side: keys in one, phone in the other.
The back. A tote gives your cards nowhere to go but the top. Here, a hidden pocket on the back sits flat against you, so your cards stay right there.
The inside. In a tote, everything ends up in one heap. Inside this bag, divided compartments keep the notebook, the wallet and the glasses apart.
So you walk out with everything in its place. Keys at the side, cards on your back, the bag on your shoulder, and nothing sliding around.

Think a big tote is the easy bag for everything?
Myth: a big open tote is the easy bag. It holds everything, it goes with everything, so it must be the one for your busy days.
Fact: it holds everything in one heap. Your phone, your keys and your wallet all slide down into the same dark corner of the bag.
Now look inside the Hobo Bag. Divided compartments give every small thing its own place, so nothing sinks to the bottom.
And when your hands are full, the strap goes crossbody. Two straps come with the bag, so you wear it on the shoulder, as a handbag or across your body.
The gold zip on each side helps too: your keys on one side, your phone on the other, both one pull away.
So on the next busy day you walk out with the bag on your shoulder, both hands free, and every single thing exactly where you put it this morning.

Busy market, phone in your hand: where do your cards go?
Here is the test. A busy Saturday market, people on every side, and an open tote on your shoulder with your cards sitting right at the top.
Now the Hobo Bag. Your cards slide into the hidden pocket on the back, the zip pulls across, and the pocket sits flat against you.
Walk the whole market, stall after stall. The cards stay right there against your body, and from the outside nobody can tell where they are.
It is the same bag you carry every day. Two gold side zips hold your keys and your phone, so your hands stay free for the shopping and the bags of fruit.
The open tote stays at home this time. This one goes on your shoulder in the morning and comes back with everything still in its place.

Tell her the leather matters. This bag is soft and water-resistant, it looks expensive, and it only gets better the more she carries it.
Because it is water-resistant, a little rain on the way to dinner is no drama, and the bag still looks good on the back of the chair.
And it zips shut. A gold zip on each side holds her keys and her phone, so nothing tips out of an open top.
Then the weekend: the same bag at the market, at brunch and on the walk home, and it still looks good on Sunday night.
She wears it on her shoulder all week, from the office to the dinner table and back home, and on Friday it still looks like new.
